findings: Device-number comparison does not distinguish a same-filesystem bind mount.
No remaining-deadline check after the root context completes cleanup.

limitations: Prototype uses fake filesystem/root-context tests; actual Linux FD, mount and resource behavior is not verified.
Complete metadata coverage is not a consistent backup or sufficient-capacity proof.
Symlink metadata is counted without following the target; hard links are counted per entry.
nextStep: Disclosed new prototype defects; proposed local-only correction: bind traversal to the actual mount instance, check deadline after root cleanup, and add root-cleanup/metadata-drift/deadline regressions. No remote execution or change to the old collector is implied.
